tax.text: He supports extending the 2017 tax cuts and further reducing individual and corporate taxes.
tax.quote: We can do this by extending the 2017 tax cuts and reducing taxes further especially to reshore jobs lost due to past policies.

debt.text: He said Social Security and Medicare benefits should remain unchanged and described them as promises that must be protected.
debt.quote: Let me be crystal clear: There are NO changes to Social Security or Medicare benefits. These are promises made to the American people, and we’re protecting them.

housing.text: He voted for legislation intended to expand housing supply and has advocated addressing regulatory delays and outdated zoning rules.
housing.quote: As part of this effort, Haridopolos voted in favor of the Housing for the 21st Century Act, a pro-growth bill aimed at expanding housing supply, modernizing federal housing programs, and strengthening community banks’ ability to finance new construction.

safety.text: He voted for four District of Columbia crime bills, including one restoring police pursuit authority.
safety.quote: H.R. 5143 - District of Columbia Policing Protection Act: Restores police authority to pursue fleeing suspects and improves real-time public safety alerts.

immigration.text: He voted to fund additional border barriers and personnel for DHS, Customs and Border Protection, and ICE.
immigration.quote: Permanently securing the Southern Border: Fully funds the president’s border security agenda, including resources to finish the wall and increase manpower at DHS, CBP, and ICE.

guns.text: His campaign says he consistently defends Second Amendment rights and will protect the right to bear arms in Congress.
guns.quote: Additionally, Mike has always been a staunch defender of our Second Amendment rights, carrying an A rating from the NRA from his service in the Florida Legislature. Mike will always protect our right to bear arms in Congress.

abortion.text: He said abortion should generally be prohibited after 15 weeks, with exceptions for rape, incest, human trafficking, and danger to the mother's life.
abortion.quote: During a recent debate with Kennedy on WESH-TV, Haridopolos said he draws the line on abortions after 15 weeks of pregnancy.

health.text: He advocates greater competition and consumer choice in health care while protecting Medicare.
health.quote: I am fighting to lower costs by increasing transparency, expanding competition, strengthening doctor-patient relationships, and giving Americans more choices in their care.

energy.text: He voted to prevent unilateral federal bans on fracking, citing domestic production, jobs, and lower consumer costs.
energy.quote: Washington, D.C. – On Friday, Congressman Mike Haridopolos (FL-08) joined House Republicans in passing the Protecting American Energy Production Act, which will restore America’s energy dominance, create jobs, and lower families' costs.

voting.text: He co-sponsored legislation establishing photo identification and proof-of-citizenship requirements for federal elections.
voting.quote: Requiring photo ID and proof of citizenship is a common-sense step to restoring trust in our elections.

trade.text: Jenkins says she will oppose tariffs that increase the cost of everyday goods.
trade.quote: Oppose reckless tariffs that drive up the cost of everyday goods.

debt.text: Jenkins identifies protecting Social Security and Medicare as a reason she is running for Congress.
debt.quote: I’m running for affordability, public education, protecting Social Security and Medicare, defending reproductive freedom, and lowering costs for working families.

schools.text: Jenkins supports federal funding for public schools, higher educator pay, disability services, and efforts to address teacher shortages.
schools.quote: Raise teacher pay and strengthen our public schools. I will fight for federal legislation that helps states raise educator salaries, fully funds our commitments to students with disabilities, and addresses the teacher shortage.

immigration.text: Jenkins supports expanding legal immigration pathways and offering Dreamers and qualifying long-term undocumented residents an earned path to legal status and citizenship.
immigration.quote: We should invest in border security and faster asylum processing, expand legal pathways for workers and families, and give Dreamers and long-term undocumented residents who work, pay taxes, and follow the law an earned pathway to legal status and citizenship.

guns.text: Jenkins called for universal background checks, red-flag laws, and firearm safe-storage requirements.
guns.quote: I’ve had enough. I’m starting a petition in support of universal background checks, red flag laws, and safe storage requirements.

abortion.text: Jenkins says defending reproductive freedom is a central purpose of her congressional campaign.
abortion.quote: I’m running for affordability, public education, protecting Social Security and Medicare, defending reproductive freedom, and lowering costs for working families.

gender.text: As a school-board member, Jenkins sought a gubernatorial veto of Florida legislation banning transgender students from participating in sports consistent with their gender identity.
gender.quote: Board member Jenkins asked if the Board would consider writing a letter to Governor DeSantis asking him to veto SB 1028; part of which is a ban on trans sports.

health.text: Jenkins pledges to expand Medicaid so more Floridians receive coverage without relying on emergency care or incurring medical debt.
health.quote: Expand Medicaid so Floridians aren’t forced into emergency care or medical debt.

energy.text: Jenkins supports reducing climate pollution while investing in clean energy, grid improvements, and resilient infrastructure.
energy.quote: Protecting our economy requires both reducing the pollution driving climate change and preparing our communities for impacts we are already experiencing.

voting.text: Jenkins opposes ending voting by mail and supports federal voting-rights legislation.
voting.quote: Donald Trump and MAGA want to END Vote-by-Mail.
